name: storage
lead: A per-pack JSON file that survives a restart.

functions.name: status
functions.description: Last persistence error and whether there are unsaved changes.

functions.name: flush
functions.description: Yields until saved; raises an error on failure. After initialization only.

functions.name: get
functions.description: Returns the value saved under `key`, or nil when there is none.

functions.name: set
functions.description: Saves a value under `key` in this pack's storage.json; nil forgets it.

functions.name: keys
functions.description: Every key, sorted; with a prefix, only those that start with it.

title: storage global
